rule.text: every witness is refined before it is counted -- not the ones near the floor, all of them
rule.relationship_to_WIT01: WIT-01 is not withdrawn. It stays for the sub-grid case it does catch. Retro-applied it removes nothing -- admissibility ratio 1.000 in all three charts -- because every pair qualifies on a doping magnitude and magnitudes reach the grid exactly, so it is not sufficient either.
rule.why_no_threshold: the observed refinement split sits between 92.2% and 93.65% of the distinguishability floor, 1.4 percentage points. A threshold inside a band that narrow is tuned; PH-11 forbids it. Refining every witness needs no threshold to defend.

provenance.git_dirty_is_not_a_gate: the inputs are pinned by digest, so a dirty tree cannot have changed what was read; this differs from a solving run, where the working tree IS the measurement

verdict.why_not_repaired_here: refining the uncovered pairs is new solving. The closing ruling section 5 allows arithmetic on existing artefacts only and orders a stop; there is no generation 11. The gap is registered rather than closed, and WITNESS-04 carries it as load-bearing.
verdict.reading: chart J is the only committed witness set that satisfies WIT-02. Chart G is partially covered -- generation 6's battery refined three of its thirteen pairs and all three survived. Chart L is uncovered, and it is the set the dimension reading rests on.
